scope: Four primary complete CAD cases plus cyclic-4; interval construction; four repetitions; independent complete scalar and SIMD acceptance each repetition.
notes: One pinned execution CPU; no overlapping task compiler or benchmark work during timed runs. Shared host contention remains uncontrolled.
Timing includes preparation, cache creation, packing, bounds, tails, exact fallback and final cache flush.
M1-M5 full-bank gate remains open: piano-mover was deferred by the owner; no piano rerun in M6.
No algebraic SIMD or modular identity shortcut added; exact scalar algebraic checking retained.

regression_policy.policy: Before candidate measurements: allowed relative certified-total regression is max(5%, twice the baseline full range divided by its median). Report verifier-only and scalar/SIMD differences separately.
